opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 for Scheme (A), up to £500 for Scheme (B), up to £300 for Scheme (C).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligibility varies by scheme: Scheme (A) is open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and to postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva. Schemes (B) & (C) are open to PhD student and postdoctoral scientist members within six years of their PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference they wish to attend with Genetics Society support.
opportunities.summary: The purpose of these grants is to support the attendance of Genetics Society “junior scientist” members at conferences on research in Genetics. The scheme has three main streams: (A) to support attendance at meetings organised directly by the Genetics Society or sponsored by the Society as a Special Interest Group (SIG); (B) to support attendance at non-Genetics Society meetings; and (C) to support attendance of virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or the course you wish to attend is being held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members. Others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: The Genetics Society can help with grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or you intend to carry out your fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members. Others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: The Genetics Society has made awards up to £2,000 available to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project. The research should produce results that would typically be suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 for host laboratory expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The Summer Studentship scheme is open to all undergraduate students, except those in their first or final year. The project must be based at a UK university. We will not provide funding for travel to get to the UK from overseas.
opportunities.summary: Grants available to support undergraduate students to gain experience in any area of genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree.

opportunities.title: Communicating Your Science Workshop

amount.raw: Covers travel, accommodation, and meals for successful applicants

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The course is open to PhD student and postdoctoral researcher Society members working in genetics and related areas.
opportunities.summary: This workshop brings together experts in different fields to help participants explore and develop their communication skills.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member can apply, regardless of age of person they are caring for.
opportunities.summary: An award of (up to) £60/day to be used as you think will best support your attendance at a Society meeting.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting

amount.raw: Several levels of sponsorship are possible, up to several thousand pounds

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members may apply at any time of the year and we encourage members to submit at least three months in advance of their event to allow the application to be reviewed.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Grants of up to £1,000 are available to members of the Genetics Society to support public engagement activities related to genetics.
opportunities.summary: Grants available to support public engagement activities related to genetics.

opportunities.title: SIG
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Funding up to £2,000 per year is available for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £2,000 per year is available for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings.
